svg.title: Modeer Almalaaeb — compact React component hierarchy
svg.desc: BrowserRouter, AuthProvider, LiveProvider and App compose AppRouter and authentication/application layouts. Twenty routed page components cover twenty-one URL patterns. Each route card continues its layout PageOutlet, shows route guards and direct children. Room slots and pool controls are inline UI; groups of kind team serve cups; messages need no Conversation model; sports news comes from an external API.
svg.text: 20 page components · 21 route patterns · seven-model project · React / JavaScript / JSX
Route branches — each card continues the matching PageOutlet; arrows inside cards show direct children.
kind = social or team; one Group model
Entries / fixtures are embedded Cup data
Guards use current API-authorized state. Room history uses kickoff membership; attendance uses the fixed completion host.
Group(kind=team) supplies cup teams. Slots are inline Room data; friendship and cup consent use Membership; chat uses Message.
